    Multiply(a: Quaternion, scalar: Number): Quaternion

## Line 75

**Source:** [stdlib/foundation/rotations-ops.library.plato, line 75](../../../../../stdlib/foundation/rotations-ops.library.plato#L75).

```plato

    //==
    // Rotation composition

    // The Hamilton product, in System.Numerics operand order: the vector parts
    // give a cross term plus the scalar-weighted vectors, and the scalar part
    // loses the vector dot product.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quaternion#Hamilton_product
    Multiply(a: Quaternion, b: Quaternion): Quaternion {
        var cx = a.Y * b.Z - a.Z * b.Y;
        var cy = a.Z * b.X - a.X * b.Z;
        var cz = a.X * b.Y - a.Y * b.X;
        var dot = a.X * b.X + a.Y * b.Y + a.Z * b.Z;
        return (a.X * b.W + b.X * a.W + cx,
                a.Y * b.W + b.Y * a.W + cy,
                a.Z * b.W + b.Z * a.W + cz,
                a.W * b.W - dot);
    }
```
